- tvs-rating@pwr_in1: VRWM≥13.2V / VC≤24V(SMAJ/SMBJ 系列按此筛)

- reg-caps@ldo1: 见 notes(惯例值)
- thermal@ldo1: Tj≈136°C(裕量-30°C)
- led-resistor@led_pwr: 推荐 270(就近换表内值)
- led-resistor@led_act: 推荐 270(就近换表内值)
